ui.advancedSearch.title: Advanced Search
ui.advancedSearch.help.title: How Advanced Search works
ui.advancedSearch.help.rows: Each row checks one stat. Type part of a stat's name in the row's field and pick it from the list, then fill in <hl>Min</hl>, <hl>Max</hl> or both. Leave a side blank for no limit. <hl>Clear</hl> empties the field and <hl>X</hl> removes the row. A row with no stat picked is ignored.
ui.advancedSearch.help.totals: A row looks at the item's total for its stat: every line of that stat, implicits and explicits added together, as the item shows them. Min and Max include the value itself. A reduction counts as negative, so to find a reduction of at least 10%, set <hl>Max</hl> to -10. An item without the stat fails the row, even with both sides blank. For a stat that scales with hull size, the row passes if any hull size is in range.
ui.advancedSearch.help.groups: Rows sit in groups. An <hl>And</hl> group passes when every one of its rows passes. A <hl>Count</hl> group passes when at least as many of its rows pass as the number beside it, such as any 2 of 4. An item has to pass every group to be shown. <hl>Add modifier</hl> adds a row to a group, and the buttons at the bottom add new groups.
ui.advancedSearch.help.apply: Rows and groups take effect when you press <hl>Search</hl> or <hl>Enter</hl>, and stay in effect after this window closes. <hl>Reset</hl> clears every group. The panel's own search box applies on top.
ui.advancedSearch.group.and.tooltip: Items need every row in this group.
ui.advancedSearch.group.count.tooltip: Items need at least this many rows in this group.
ui.advancedSearch.min.tooltip: The lowest total of this stat, as the item shows it. Leave it blank for no limit.
ui.advancedSearch.max.tooltip: The highest total of this stat, as the item shows it. Leave it blank for no limit. A reduction counts as negative.
ui.advancedSearch.picker.tooltip: Type to narrow the list, then click a stat.
